references.text: The original instruction for making the breastpiece, specifying the same measurements: a span long and a span wide, double-layered and square.
The introduction to the description of the breastpiece (חֹשֶׁן) that was to be made for the high priest.
The preceding verse describing how the breastpiece was made with skilled workmanship, in the same way as the ephod.
Mentions onyx stones and setting stones for the ephod and the breastpiece as part of the materials to be gathered.
Moses attached the breastpiece to Aaron and placed the Urim and Thummim in it during the consecration of the priests.
